scope: existing artifacts only; no model construction, training, or inference
interpretation_limits: Single seed 1234 on a repeatedly exposed development holdout; not an independent confirmatory test.
U0 is a historical round2 reference on identical split/statistics/query rows and budget; no contemporaneous unchanged U0 retraining.
A1 versus A0 isolates residual coordinate choice at identical parameter count; A0 versus U0 also adds frame inputs and 22659 parameters.
G arms add both anchor information and capacity versus A0; graph versus pointwise and phase versus static must use within-G contrasts.
G active additional parameter mismatch is approximately 0.96%, not exact equality.
Wall-clock training/inference observations share cluster hardware; they are not a controlled throughput benchmark.
